# Sparkle Dental PA (Kutztown, PA)

> Compassionate, family, and restorative dental clinic led by Dr. Subhashini Pamulapati, DDS (NYU College of Dentistry).

## Practice Overview
- **Name:** Sparkle Dental
- **Lead Clinician:** Dr. Subhashini Pamulapati, DDS ("Dr. Subha")
- **Address:** 15295 Kutztown Rd, Kutztown, PA 19530
- **Phone:** (610) 683-6955
- **Email:** smile@sparkledentalpa.com
- **Website:** https://sparkledentalpa.com/
- **Hours:** Monday & Wednesday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM; 1st Saturday of month 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Tue/Thu/Fri/Sun Closed.

## Core Clinical Services
- **Restorative:** Custom porcelain & zirconia crowns, dental bridges, complete and partial dentures, gentle root canals, dental implants.
- **Preventive:** Ultrasonic dental cleanings, periodontal evaluations, digital radiography, oral cancer screenings.
- **Pediatric:** Friendly, stress-free children's dental exams, fluoride treatments, and cavity prevention.
- **Cosmetic & Bleaching:** Take-home professional bleaching kits, aesthetic bonding, and smile makeovers.
- **Urgent Care:** Same-day emergency dental relief for toothaches, chipped teeth, and trauma.

## Insurance & Financing
- Accepts most dental PPO plans with direct billing.
- Accepts select Medicare HMO dental insurances.
- CareCredit financing with 0% APR options and flexible in-house monthly arrangements.
